authority: Proposed; pending user approval. Motivated by 15 live runs (2026-09) and the sketch design that the dispatcher, not the driving LLM, runs the evidence chain (S4.1-S4.2, S4.6, S4.8; S4.2 section 7 for recovery).
classification: architecture regression: LLM-mediated hops (facade projection of S4.1-S4.2), not a policy change
input_and_actual: Across 15 live runs the facade tools were 13% of agent wall time (138 s of 1,099 s); the other 87% was the driving LLM (about 2.9 s per turn, 374 turns). The facade exposed read, choose, act, verify and finish as separate MCP tools, so the LLM mediated every hop: a clean booking took 9 LLM-visible calls where native tools take about 5. Nothing in the repo noticed the drift. Live test of the first cua_do (Sonnet 5.5, real Chrome): booking took 8 LLM-visible calls and 20 turns (native 8 calls, 18 turns), orders 13 calls and 33 turns (native 6 and 14). Causes: (1) with eight tools visible the LLM called cua_windows and cua_observe itself before cua_do; (2) cua_do deferred records_ambiguous on BOTH real pages because Chrome advertises AXPress on every static text, cell and row, so discovery keyed on repeated press-capable nodes and listed every repeated element; (3) orders rows have two buttons (Track, Cancel) and cua_do had no way to name one; (4) the LLM never passed expect, so verification fell to the screenshot model, which answered unknown; (5) cua_choose exact answered exact_target_not_unique for "Yes, cancel order" while cua_do found it unique: the dialog buttons had no AXPress in that snapshot, so exact mode (press-capable nodes only) saw the control as absent; the confirm dialog is page content, not an AXSheet. Independent review of the live-shape fixes found shapes the two captured trees did not cover: a success toast with an Undo button read as a confirm dialog (a successful booking deferred, or with confirm="Undo" pressed Undo); per-record labels ("Book Dr A") and single-record pages ended in records_ambiguous with a record_ids hint a cua_do-only caller cannot use; 5+ control dialogs missed by a 1..4 cutoff and a list gaining a card read as a one-control dialog; identity defaulting to all fields deferred the normal orders flow; verify-only and the click path accepted button labels and pre-existing text as proof; a disabled matching record was reported as "no record satisfies the predicates".
corrected_behavior: cua_do runs the chain server-side in one call (observe, read, same-record filter, chooser only if several remain, bind, act with S4.8 revalidation, independent verify) and recovers in bounded deterministic code: stale UI or shifted indices reobserve and re-run the whole pipeline with a NEW selection (at most 2 passes, never reusing a stale selection or its tokens, a different fresh pick is a real change and defers); a pre-click Driver/provider failure is retried once after a short backoff (never a click); an unknown field is re-read once; verification escalates AX, then Perception (never satisfying on digits), then the screenshot model; a dialog after the click is never pressed unless the caller opted in with confirm=<exact label>, the dialog's displayed identity matches the selected record completely and exactly one enabled control in the new dialog has that label (never the chooser; otherwise it defers confirm_dialog_present, and a pre-existing, replaced or extra dialog defers confirm_dialog_ambiguous); after a stale refusal recovery requires a complete, unique record identity or it defers record_changed_unverifiable; expect text already on the page before the click, or the text just typed, is unproven and never done; once any click is delivered no selection is handed back; a hard cap of 3x budget_s counts click time too. It returns deferred/failed to the LLM only for (A) a click that may have been delivered but could not be verified, (B) ambiguity (several eligible records, an unknown competitor without accept_unknown, records_ambiguous) and (C) a real content change inside the bound scope that alters which record matches. A clean run is 1 LLM-visible call as MEASURED through the real server tools under a minimal LLM policy (the response reports follow_up_needed, not a call count); specialists still do all reading, matching and choosing. The primitives remain as Advanced escape hatches with unchanged behavior. CALL_BUDGET.json, scripts/check_call_budget.py, a skill lint and the live scorer keep it that way. Live fixes: only cua_do is registered by default (the eight primitives need CUA_TASK_ADVANCED=1) and no deferral or hint ever sends the caller to a primitive; every deferral carries what a second cua_do needs; records are keyed on the repeated ACTIONABLE control inside the page content (button/link/menu item/radio/checkbox roles, AXColumn copies skipped), never repeated static text; control names which button per record (control_needed lists only those labels); expect is a required schema parameter (null ends delivered_unverified, never done); operation="verify" re-checks without clicking; a confirm dialog is detected as new page content (not by role), identified from its own new text, and a control without a press action is reobserved once then deferred (control_not_pressable); cua_choose exact gains an additive diagnostic instead of a misleading "not unique". Review fixes: expect is checked FIRST and only against text-bearing non-control nodes in the page content (never a button label, never present-before, verify-only answers observed, presence only); a dialog is a region (all-new sibling subtrees, role-tagged or >= 2 controls, not list growth), so toasts and grown lists are not dialogs and 5/8-button dialogs are; identity defaults to the fields the eq predicates constrain and a partially shown identity defers confirm_identity_partial with the exact records.identity for next time; discovery falls back to structure (per-record labels) and a single actionable candidate, control matches exactly or by whole-word prefix, and every hint uses only cua_do parameters; a disabled matching record defers record_disabled, several top-level web areas defer web_area_ambiguous, and a page with nothing to press returns dead_end with report_to_user. The budget is measured with a scripted LLM that knows only goal, expect and predicates and learns the rest from deferrals; it covers the shape corpus. No tree captured from an unrelated real site exists yet (capturing one needs the user's consent), so the budgets remain fixture-derived.
tempting_wrong_repair: A lean path that drops specialist offloading (the LLM reads and picks itself); speeding up the specialists (they are 13% of the time); merging tools without a budget so the count creeps back; making cua_do call the chooser for grounded singletons or read twice; letting recovery rebind the consumed selection or loop until stable; retrying a click or anything after a click may have been delivered; treating delivery or an unknown verification as success; dumping the full observation into the response. Also: confirming a dialog because its identity matches, or because its only control is the affirmative one; handing a selection back after a click; recovering by empty or non-unique identity; counting text that was already on the page as proof; a call-count literal in the response; a harness that makes one call per scenario by construction; budgets that count only non-click time. Also: defining a record by any press-capable node; keeping eight tools visible and hoping the LLM stays on cua_do; hints that say use cua_choose or cua_verify; an optional expect; detecting dialogs only by AXSheet/AXDialog role; validating only against tidy synthetic fixtures. Also: treating any new controls as a dialog; letting identity text inside a toast authorize a control; a count cutoff for dialog size; identity defaulting to all fields; counting button labels or pre-existing text as proof; hints that ask for record_ids; a budget policy that already knows control, identity and labels.

adjacent_holes: Live A/B against the native arm is pending; the budgets are fake-fixture ceilings, not measured live accuracy. Regions mode inside cua_do relies on Perception being healthy and on quoted-label corroboration. A dialog after a non-record click cannot be identity-checked and defers, and any dialog is only pressed with an explicit confirm label. Post-click verification observes again (one extra Driver observation) rather than reusing the act revalidation snapshot. The sketch text is unchanged; proposed wording for S4.2 section 7 (the recovery table) is in the branch report. Expect text present before the click is never proof, even if the click did change the page; an outcome that reuses pre-existing text needs a different expect or the primitives. Confirm-dialog detection is a content diff bounded to 1-4 new controls in the web area: a dialog with more controls, or one rendered outside the web area, is not detected as a dialog. AX action advertisement varies between snapshots; one bounded reobserve is the only mitigation. The live A/B against the native arm must be rerun with the primitives hidden before the one-call claim is measured rather than modeled. Still unproven: no captured tree from an unrelated real site (needs the user's consent), so the shape corpus is synthetic and every budget is fixture-derived. Structural discovery treats same-shaped siblings as records; two same-shaped unrelated regions would be read as records (fails closed on missing control or identity). A dialog that is not a sibling run of new nodes (an overlay re-parenting existing nodes) is not detected.
